name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Fort Worth TX (Sylvania)

fieldNotes.site: GXO occupies Suite 100 of a large multi-tenant flex/industrial building in the North Fort Worth (N Sylvania Ave) industrial park. The pin and address resolve to the northern building; Street View confirms GXO branding (GXO box truck parked at curb, GXO signage visible).
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or guard booth. The truck court is entered via a fully open driveway off N Sylvania Ave. Only a low (~4 ft) decorative ornamental metal fence with hedge runs along the road frontage — purely cosmetic, not a security checkpoint.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Recessed dock courts along the building's east face; multi-tenant building so GXO uses only a portion. Estimated ~24 doors across the building's dock face from overhead imagery — low confidence on exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No marked trailer-drop stalls. The east-side paved area is predominantly marked auto/employee parking with a recessed dock apron — no dedicated trailer storage observed.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Open paved apron at the recessed dock court could hold roughly a dozen trailers if used for staging; low confidence.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single open driveway serves both entry and exit to the shared truck court.
